UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_enabled_too: Highlights only loose items currently visible to your character.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_color_toolt: Choose the highlight color. The default is yellow-orange.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_toggle_key_: Press this key in game to enable or disable highlighting.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_radius_tool: Search radius in tiles. Highlights loose items on loaded tiles around the player.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_button_tooltip: Click to toggle item highlights. Shortcut: %1. Change it in Options > Mods > PZ Survivor Toolkit.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_media_windo: TV & Radio ReInvented: inventory and outside clicks keep the window open; use the close button. Disable to restore the original behavior.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_sidebar_but: Show the item-highlight toggle in the left sidebar. You can still use the shortcut or Mod Options when hidden.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_clothing_ne: Show zero protection changes in grey
Use neutral grey for zero changes in the Wear menu. Disable to keep the original game colours.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_vhs_control: Click a loaded tape to eject it. Select tapes from reachable containers or drag them onto the slot. Fully watched tapes have the inventory checkmark.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_vhs_slot_tooltip: Click to select a VHS from your inventory or nearby containers. Drag a VHS here to insert it. Click a loaded tape to eject it.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_inventory_f: Select a category beside the Category heading. CleanUI searches show only matches; no matches show an empty list. Bulk transfers respect the visible items.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_bulk_disman: Adds a bulk dismantle command for selected watches and other electronics. Skips favourites and worn/held items. Uses normal recipes, tools, time and XP.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_bulk_remove: Adds bulk removal using the native Remove Battery recipe. Skips favourites and worn/held items. Devices remain intact; batteries retain their charge.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_bulk_unload: Queues native unloading for selected loaded magazines and firearms with integral magazines. Skips favourites and worn/held items. Does not eject detachable magazines or rack chambers.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_bulk_remove: Queues native removal of every detachable part from selected weapons. Respects native tool requirements; skips favourites and worn/held items.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_remove_attachments_: Remove all parts from selected weapons (%1)
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_medicine_sy: Read active medicine effects from the server in multiplayer. Lemongrass shows an estimated maximum cooldown. Disable to restore the original mod behavior.
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_medicine_he: Show active herbal pain relief (black sage) and cold relief (common mallow), including dried herbs.
UI_PZSurvivorToolkit_medicine_pending: The medicine needs some time to take effect
UI_options_PZSurvivorToolkit_navigator_t: Preserves Navigator's original textured housing and fits its tint and position to vanilla and Realistic Dashboard panels. Follows dashboard size; keeps text and buttons readable. Disable to restore Navigator's original appearance.
